events.title: International Procrastination Championship
events.description: A prestigious competition where participants compete to see who can postpone the most tasks while doing absolutely nothing productive. Snacks are mandatory.

events.title: World's Most Useless Hackathon
events.description: Build something nobody asked for. Solve problems that don't exist. Win absolutely nothing. Welcome to the most useless hackathon on Earth.

events.title: Midnight Maggi Engineering Summit
events.description: A scientific investigation into why Maggi tastes 73% better after midnight. Engineers, scientists and hungry students are invited.

events.title: Sleep During Lecture Olympics
events.description: Participants compete in sleeping through the longest lecture without getting caught. Bonus points for convincing the professor that you were thinking deeply.

events.title: Ctrl + C, Ctrl + V Festival
events.description: Celebrating the two keyboard shortcuts responsible for approximately 87% of student assignments.

events.title: 404: Motivation Not Found
events.description: A motivational seminar for people who have 17 assignments, 3 projects and absolutely zero motivation.

events.title: Debugging at 3 AM
events.description: Come discover why your code magically works after staring at it for four hours. Coffee will be available. Sleep will not.

events.title: The Great Hostel Room Cleaning Day
events.description: An extremely rare event where students voluntarily clean their rooms. Archaeologists will be present to document the discovery of the floor.
